hooks.command: h=/opt/devshop-current/hooks/review-hook.py; if [ -x "$h" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null; then exec "$h" post; fi

input=$(cat); h=/opt/devshop-current/hooks/review-hook.py; if [ -x "$h" ] && command -v python3 >/dev/null; then printf '%s' "$input" | "$h" gate && exit 0; exit 2; fi; if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -Eq 'create_pull_request|update_pull_request|update_pull_request_branch|push_files|create_or_update_file|delete_file|gh +pr +(create|edit)|git .*push'; then echo "devshop: the reviewer hook ($h) or python3 is missing, so this call cannot be reviewed and is blocked. Tell the owner." >&2; exit 2; fi
